description: Afghanistan - Road Network is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Transport", published or maintained by Alexandros Korkovelos (World Bank Group). The dataset provides existing and planned road infrastructure in Afghanistan. Data Source: The World Bank Group. Open Street Maps have been used as a complementary source. Latest update: 2012 Comment: Many of the roads that are characterized as under construction, or planned, may now be completed. Coverage: Afghanistan. It has 1 file in ZIP. The portal files it under Transport. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
